# UCC ACM Student Chapter

> UCC's ACM Student Chapter is a student organisation at University College Cork (Cork, Ireland). It promotes IT events such as competitive programming events, and hosts UCC ACM IRLCPC, the Irish Collegiate Programming Competition.

## Upcoming event: UCC ACM IRLCPC 2027

- Name: UCC ACM IRLCPC 2027 (Irish Collegiate Programming Competition)
- Date: 6 March 2027
- Venue: to be confirmed
- Registration: to be confirmed
- Schedule: provisional, times to be confirmed
- Details: https://acm.ucc.ie/#events

- [Home](https://acm.ucc.ie/): about the chapter, IRLCPC 2027, schedule, partners, team and contact details
